notes.title: Corpse Disaster-Survivor reset version update! ! !
notes.content:
This update
-Increase enemy ai
-Recreate zombie ai
-Replace all models in the scene
-Plot update
-Firearms update (pistol, shotgun, submachine gun)
-Added a csgo box-drawing system
-Added multiplayer online
-Improved image quality and settings
-Added the card selection system
-Added cutscenes and character models
-Added at least 5 more background music
-Changed the sound of firearms
-Added melee weapons
-Added grappling hook system
-Overturn all levels and do it again
-Increased the degree of the author's glasses
